name: print-social-digital-leaders-schedule-with-cyan-and-white-agenda-rows
title: 'Digital Leaders' conference schedule with cyan and white agenda rows and teal glass spheres
whatItIs: A portrait dark teal poster with 'DIGITAL' white and 'LEADERS' cyan, a rounded glass panel titled 'Schedule' with time pills and session rows — cyan for breaks, white for keynotes with speaker and talk — a host credit, sponsor boxes and glowing teal spheres and rings at the corners.
whatItMeans: Professional and techy; colour-coded rows make a busy agenda easy to scan.
techniques: Colour-code rows by type (break vs talk).
Pair each row with a separate time pill.
Frame the agenda in a glass panel.
Place glowing spheres at corners for depth.

vocabulary.definition: A line in a schedule with time and session.
